title: Drunken Monk
description: Machine-generated payloads living plainly in the md: a ````drunken-monk fence (four ticks — the plugin-fence boundary; a three-tick fence is a code block, always) carries a monk banner + a sealed base64 envelope; installed and enabled, the serve-time filter decodes it into style/script/html behaviour — ONLY envelopes sealed by the admin mint route (host HMAC integrity stamp; a hand-crafted fence degrades to the visible notice — editors cannot forge what admins mint).
